name: Chat Bot Alpha Interface
author: alphainterface

sections.description:
The Chat Bot Alpha Interface plugin allows you to easily integrate the web component directly into your WordPress site via a CDN, without manually embedding scripts.

You can configure the following in WP Admin > Settings > Chat Bot Settings:

  • Agent UUID
  • API URL
  • Chat ID
  • Icon Size
  • Chatbot Width
  • Chatbot Height

This chatbot supports voice, customization options, and backend integration via Alpha Interface.

Source Code

The uncompressed, human-readable source code for this plugin can be found at:
https://github.com/clockhash-projects/hash-bot-fe
sections.installation:
1. Upload the alpha-interface-dynamic-bot.zip file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. The chatbot widget will appear on every page of your website.

short_description: Embed a modern AI voice chatbot on your WordPress site using Alpha Interface’s  widget. Lightweight, fast, and customizable.
